scope: Append-only pure approval-consumption evaluator; not active Runtime enforcement, a command path, provider, chemistry, evaluation, replication, paper, training, release, or SOTA evidence.

supported: The isolated evaluator has only digest-based inputs and returns a library-only verdict under its tested invariants.
qualified: The contract is a prospective Runtime V2 integration seam, not an active executor control.
unresolved: Durable atomic consumption, restart safety, concurrency, user-interface provenance, active execution integration, scientific validity, held-out outcomes, replication, and paper readiness.
rejected: This receipt authorizes an action or demonstrates an active executor, chemistry result, provider capability, evaluation result, release, or SOTA.

failure_ledger.limitation: A later process could evaluate the same facts again.
failure_ledger.rollback_boundary: Require separately approved durable storage and concurrency design before active integration.
